Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as solid jobs data fuels hawkish Fed bets
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower on Friday after a stronger-than-expected jobs report increased expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike this month. Investors are now awaiting upcoming consumer and producer price inflation data for further clues on future monetary policy.

Markets.title: Strong jobs report fuels Fed rate hike prospects as Trump escalates rate cut pressure
Markets.summary: A strong U.S. jobs report has increased expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates in September, despite pressure from Donald Trump to cut them. Markets are now awaiting upcoming inflation data to determine the Fed's next policy decision.

Markets.title: Gland Pharma block deal: Fosun Pharma divests 99 lakh shares worth Rs 2,800 crore
Markets.summary: Fosun Pharma sold a 6% stake in Gland Pharma for ₹2,800 crore through a block deal, reducing its total holding to 45.77%. Major institutional buyers included Kotak, Axis, and ICICI Prudential Mutual Funds, while Gland Pharma shares closed higher at ₹2,932.40.

Markets.title: Lululemon’s turnaround gets tougher as new CEO inherits a battered brand; shares fall 20%
Markets.summary: Lululemon shares fell 20% after the sportswear maker lowered its full-year sales forecast due to declining sales in its signature leggings business and rising competition from Alo and Vuori. New CEO Heidi O'Neill now faces the challenge of regaining customer relevance and sales growth for the battered brand.

Markets.title: US stocks today: S&P 500, Dow  stocks slip as stronger jobs report lifts rate-hike bets
Markets.summary: US stocks fell after a stronger-than-expected August jobs report increased expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in September. Declines in companies like Lululemon and Adobe further pressured the market as investors awaited upcoming inflation data.

Markets.title: Sebi approves 3 IPOs of Cosmic PV, Monomark, RKB Global along with NSE
Markets.summary: SEBI has approved initial public offerings for Cosmic PV Power, Monomark Engineering, and RKB Global, alongside the National Stock Exchange. These approvals signal a major revival in India’s IPO market during the second half of 2026.

Geo-Political.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
Geo-Political.summary: A judge declared a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case after the jury deadlocked. The ruling leaves her future and criminal liability for the deaths of her three children unresolved.

Geo-Political.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
Geo-Political.summary: Germany has blamed Russia for a recent sabotage attack on Leipzig airport amid a wider wave of suspicious incidents across Europe. Investigators consider Russia the primary suspect in this escalating campaign of European infrastructure attacks.

Geo-Political.title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
Geo-Political.summary: Rescue workers successfully pulled survivors from a tunnel network along the Trishuli river in Nepal. Hundreds of additional workers remain trapped inside the tunnels following recent flooding.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
Geo-Political.summary: Germany's far-right AfD party is attempting to win an outright majority in the state election of Saxony-Anhalt. A victory would give the party state-level power for the first time in Germany since World War Two.

Geo-Political.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian drone struck the Ukrainian security headquarters in central Kyiv without warning. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed the attack.

Geo-Political.title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
Geo-Political.summary: The UK government stated its support for the Falkland Islands is unwavering following renewed claims by Argentinian President Javier Milei. Milei recently claimed that changing geopolitical conditions favor Argentina's sovereignty over the British overseas territory.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A marketer discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing organic traffic acquisition compared to traditional search engine optimization (SEO).

AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and simplify their workflows.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate tasks, improve workflows, and boost productivity across various industries. Data & Insights.title: 'Lower interest rates or...,' Trump turns up heat on hand-picked Fed chair Kevin Warsh, threatens trade shutdown
Data & Insights.summary: President Trump pressured Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh to lower interest rates. He also threatened to cut off trade with countries that maintain trade deficits.

Data & Insights.title: World's biggest wealth fund plans to cut government bonds, US Treasuries face $75 billion impact
Data & Insights.summary: Norway's $2.3 trillion sovereign wealth fund plans to reduce its government bond holdings from 70% to 50% to diversify risk and increase returns. Pending government approval, this shift is projected to cut the fund's US Treasury holdings by $75 billion.

Data & Insights.title: India forex reserves jump $11.5 billion to record high of $740.8 billion
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves increased by $11.5 billion, reaching a record high of $740.8 billion. This surpassed the previous peak of $728.494 billion set in late February prior to the Middle East conflict.

Data & Insights.title: E-way bill generation rises 7.7% to over 139 million in August
Data & Insights.summary: E-way bill generation increased by 7.7% to over 139 million in August. This marks the fifth consecutive month in the current fiscal year that generation has exceeded 130 million.

Data & Insights.title: iBRICS 2026: $1 trillion global sovereign capital in focus as 500 investors gather in Delhi next week
Data & Insights.summary: Next week, 500 investors will gather in Delhi for the SWFI-convened iBRICS 2026 conference. The event aims to connect one trillion dollars in global sovereign capital with infrastructure, energy, and digital projects across BRICS nations.

Data & Insights.title: GDP data row: What is Base Year, how is it revised and why has it raised a political storm? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: A base-year revision allows the government to incorporate newer data sources and improve its methodology to better capture economic changes. This process has sparked a political controversy over how the updated data reflects the economy's performance.

India.title: Air India Initiates 100% Voluntary Pilot Testing After Phuket Flight Fiasco
India.summary: Following a hydraulic failure and crew drug test issues on a Phuket flight, Air India has started 100% voluntary pilot testing. The airline is fully cooperating with ongoing technical and medical investigations regarding the incident.

India.title: FBI-Wanted Fraudster Arrested In Jalandhar Over $600,000 Scam In US
India.summary: An FBI-wanted fraudster was arrested in Jalandhar for allegedly committing a $600,000 scam in the United States. Jalandhar police registered a case regarding the fraud on August 16, 2026, and initiated an investigation.

India.title: "First Step To Victory": Teen Dalit Activist On Swatantra Bhardwaj's Detention
India.summary: Far-right activist Swatantra Bhardwaj was detained after boasting on a podcast about facing no legal consequences for attacking a Dalit activist's father. The teenage Dalit activist welcomed the detention as the first step toward achieving justice.

India.title: Omar Abdullah Meets Amit Shah, Discusses Early Restoration Of J&K's Statehood
India.summary: Omar Abdullah met with Amit Shah to discuss the early restoration of Jammu and Kashmir's statehood. This was their first interaction since Abdullah's protest in the national capital on July 20.

India.title: "Cracked His Skull" Was Not All. Far-Right Influencer Swatantra Bhardwaj's Vitriol Spanned Hour-Long Podcast
India.summary: Far-right influencer Swatantra Bhardwaj appeared on a podcast where he expressed hatred toward Muslims and made claims about political patronage. During the hour-long interview, he also made a violent remark about cracking someone's skull.

India.title: Assam Signs MoUs With 6 Firms, IIT Madras To Bring AI To Schools
India.summary: Assam has partnered with six companies and IIT Madras to pilot an artificial intelligence platform in 50 schools. This initiative also involves using another AI-based platform to help students learn mathematics and languages.

General.title: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
General.summary: Violence has escalated in Middlesbrough following a fatal crash on the A66. Local residents report that they are living in fear and refuse to contact the police.

General.title: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
General.summary: Cleveland Police Chief Victoria Fuller expressed pride in her force but stated they are being let down by a lack of funding. She believes the department needs to become part of a larger, strategic force with greater resources.

General.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
General.summary: A judge declared a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case after the jury deadlocked. The ruling leaves her criminal liability for the deaths of her three children unresolved and in limbo.

General.title: Farage threatens to overhaul Lords and judges to meet his pledges
General.summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage promises to overhaul the House of Lords and the judiciary to achieve his party's goals. He pledges to implement these changes within the first 100 days if Reform UK wins power.

General.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
General.summary: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - the US the only nation to vote against it.

General.title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
General.summary: Rescuers have saved some workers trapped in a network of tunnels running along Nepal's Trishuli river. Hundreds of other workers remain trapped inside the tunnels following floods.
